correctness.rationale: All-parameter proof covers both parities of q. Necessity invokes unique half-spin extension of rank n−1 singular U; sufficiency uses the uniform fixed-family point-incidence probability 1/(q^(r−1)+1) in a split quotient and a strict (r−1)-point union bound. Projective quotient lifts give each coefficient. All-positive adaptive path proves Ldim upper bound; static shattering proves lower. Matroid and flag counterexamples and rank-three graph homology checked from definitions. Independent binary basis-enumeration C++ and Python growth enumeration, plus a separate ternary projective enumerator, reproduced stated counts. Tests cannot replace universal proof.

value.rationale: Canonical half-spin parity is mathematically motivated by the two rulings of split orthogonal polar space. One-family restriction forces a sharp, field-independent one-rank cutoff, while quotient avoidance proves full trace interpolation below it. Uniform coefficient and online dimensions, plus pure but nonmatroidal and nonflag structure and an all-q rank-three homotopy calculation, provide a complete natural invariant rather than a small numerical variation.
